newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea '97 petrochem output seen at 12.02 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea '97 petrochem output seen at 12.02 mln tns.

text.p: South Korea's production of petrochemical products, including synthetic resins, fibres and rubbers, is expected to rise to 12.02 million tonnes next year from an estimated 10.09 million this year, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Wednesday.
The ministry said in a statement that plant capacity expansion was behind the increase in production, and would boost exports to 4.4 million tonnes next year from 3.5 million this year.
Demand was seen rising to 8.6 million tonnes in 1997 from 7.8 million in 1996.
But imports would slow slightly to 1.1 million tonnes in 1997 against 1.3 million in 1996 as a rise in domestic output would satisfy more domestic demand.
